# tharsis_runner_agent (Resource)

Defines and manages a group runner agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tharsis_runner_agent" "this" {
  name              = "my-runner-agent"
  description       = "A runner agent for a Kubernetes cluster."
  group_id          = tharsis_group.top_level.id
  run_untagged_jobs = false
  tags              = ["kubernetes", "us-east-2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID or TRN of the parent group. Runner agents are group-scoped.
- `name` (String) The name of the runner agent.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the runner agent.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the runner agent is prevented from claiming jobs. Defaults to false.
- `run_untagged_jobs` (Boolean) Whether the runner agent claims jobs that carry no tags. Defaults to false.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags that route tagged jobs to this runner agent. Changing a non-empty set to empty forces replacement, because the API cannot clear tags through an update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String identifier of the runner agent.
- `resource_path` (String) The path of the parent group plus the name of the runner agent.
